description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Runs one improve round: 3+ deliberately different samples of the entry, each with its respelling, script, transcript, word diff and accent check (`accent`, default en-US). Ask the user which sample is right and what was wrong with the others (wrong words, a note, a "say it like this" respelling), then either choose one with pronunciations_improve_choose or run another round with the same `sessionId` and ALL the `feedback` ({ round, sample, played, words, note?, sayItLike? }). CHARGES EMBERS: one charge covers up to 3 rounds (GET /api/v2/pronunciations/{id}/improve quotes it); the round after starts a new charge, and `billing.note` says so: tell the user before running it. Refunded when no sample could be made. Audio is left out unless `includeAudio` is true.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/pronunciations/{id}/improve.)

feedback.description: Feedback on earlier samples. Another round carries ALL feedback so far.

sayItLike.description: "Say it like this": a respelling to try next.

includeAudio.description: Return each sample as base64 audio. Default true (false through MCP).

sessionId.description: Continue a session (another round). Absent = start one.

name: pronunciations_improve
title: Improve a pronunciation (rounds)
